1.text: Amasekuruza ya Yesu Kristo, mwene Dawidi, mwene Aburahamu ngaya:

2.text: Aburahamu yabyaye Isaka, Isaka yabyaye Yakobo, Yakobo yabyaye Yuda na bene se,

3.text: Yuda yabyaye Peresi na Zera kuri Tamari, Peresi yabyaye Hesironi, Hesironi yabyaye Ramu,

4.text: Ramu yabyaye Aminadabu, Aminadabu yabyaye Nahashoni, Nahashoni yabyaye Salumoni,

5.text: Salumoni yabyaye Bowazi kuri Rahabu, Bowazi yabyaye Obedi kuri Rusi, Obedi yabyaye Yesayi,

6.text: Yesayi yabyaye Umwami Dawidi.Dawidi yabyaye Salomo kuri muka Uriya,

7.text: Salomo yabyaye Rehobowamu, Rehobowamu yabyaye Abiya, Abiya yabyaye Asa,

8.text: Asa yabyaye Yehoshafati, Yehoshafati yabyaye Yoramu, Yoramu yabyaye Uziya,

9.text: Uziya yabyaye Yotamu, Yotamu yabyaye Ahazi, Ahazi yabyaye Hezekiya,

10.text: Hezekiya yabyaye Manase, Manase yabyaye Amoni, Amoni yabyaye Yosiya,

11.text: Yosiya yabyaye Yekoniya na bene se, igihe bimuriwe i Babuloni.

12.text: Bamaze kwimurirwa i Babuloni, Yekoniya yabyaye Shalutiyeli, Shalutiyeli yabyaye Zerubabeli,

13.text: Zerubabeli yabyaye Abihudi, Abihudi yabyaye Eliyakimu, Eliyakimu yabyaye Azori,

14.text: Azori yabyaye Sadoki, Sadoki yabyaye Akimu, Akimu yabyaye Elihudi,

15.text: Elihudi yabyaye Eleyazari, Eleyazari yabyaye Matani, Matani yabyaye Yakobo,

16.text: Yakobo yabyaye Yosefu umugabo wa Mariya, ari we nyina wa Yesu witwa Kristo.

17.text: Nuko ba sekuruza bose, uhereye kuri Aburahamu ukageza kuri Dawidi ni cumi na bane, kandi uhereye kuri Dawidi ukageza igihe bimuriwe i Babuloni ni cumi na bane, kandi uhereye icyo gihe bimuriwe i Babuloni ukageza kuri Kristo ni cumi na bane.

18.text: Kuvuka kwa Yesu Kristo kwagenze gutya. Nyina Mariya yari yarasabwe na Yosefu, ariko yari ataramurongora, babona afite inda y'Umwuka Wera.

19.text: Umugabo we Yosefu kuko yari umukiranutsi kandi adashaka kumukoza isoni ku mugaragaro, yigira inama yo kumubenga rwihishwa.

20.text: Akibitekereza, marayika w'Umwami Imana amubonekera mu nzozi ati “Yosefu mwene Dawidi, witinya kurongora umugeni wawe Mariya, kuko imbuto imurimo ari iy'Umwuka Wera.

21.text: Azabyara umuhungu uzamwite YESU, kuko ari we uzakiza abantu be ibyaha byabo.”

22.text: Nuko ibyo byose byabereyeho kugira ngo ibyo Umwami Imana yavugiye mu kanwa k'umuhanuzi bisohore ngo

23.text: “Dore umwari azasama inda kandi azabyara umuhungu,Azitwa Imanweli”,risobanurwa ngo “Imana iri kumwe natwe”.

24.text: Yosefu akangutse abigenza uko marayika w'Umwami Imana yamutegetse, arongora umugeni we.

25.text: Ariko ntibaryamana arinda ageza igihe yabyariye umuhungu, amwita YESU.
